calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: spot ~$1,333, Oct 1 close $1,335.01, Sep 27 peak $1,697, ETF outflows ~$93M, OI -13.5%, no catalyst dated Oct 5-15, and no matching market. The CoinGecko API date shifts were reported differently but each run aligned on the Oct 1 close, so the values agree. What remained was judgment: (1) drift — run 2 slightly negative, runs 1 and 3 zero; with no evidence breaking the tie between bearish momentum and support holding, I bet on zero drift; (2) volatility of 18-20% — I adopt ~19% with mildly fat tails, in line with runs 1 and 3; (3) escape mass — I price ~1% each side, with the mechanisms named. The percentiles follow from the stated dispersion rather than from averaging the runs.
